title: Tracking: Native/Desktop sovereign frame driver and display refresh integration
symptoms: On non-WASM / native platforms (macOS, Windows, Linux, Blitz desktop), animations do not advance automatically without an explicit frame driver because no hosted display-link or winit event-loop driver is active. Current runtime advances via explicit oxidase::frame::tick(dt) or Motion::tick(dt).
cause: Dioxus Desktop and Blitz currently lack a standardized, cross-platform public Rust animation frame hook tied to OS V-Sync (macOS CVDisplayLink, Windows DwmFlush, Wayland presentation time, or winit RedrawRequested). Upstream oxidase 0.1.3 provides deterministic manual/headless ticking, while hosted native auto-looping remains tracked in oxidase ISSUE-0001.
solution: 1) Monitor upstream oxidase hosted native frame loop resolution (tracked in oxidase ISSUE-0001) and Blitz winit redraw cycle hook capabilities (use_window_event on WindowEvent::RedrawRequested). 2) Maintain kinetoxus delegation to oxidase::frame. 3) Preserve deterministic manual ticking for unit/integration testing while consuming hosted native loop automatically when active.
